front: What is Flutter build and release in one sentence?
back: Compile Dart to native ARM/x64 binaries and platform bundles — debug fast, profile jank, release with obfuscation, signing, and store-ready artifacts.

front: What is Android?
back: Gradle wraps flutter build apk/appbundle; signing via keystore.

front: What is iOS?
back: Xcode archive; provisioning profiles + App Store Connect.

front: What is Web?
back: flutter build web → CanvasKit or skwasm renderer.

front: Explain the mental model of Flutter build and release (how the system thinks).
back: Platform shells: Android — Gradle wraps flutter build apk/appbundle; signing via keystore. iOS — Xcode archive; provisioning profiles + App Store Connect. Web — flutter build web → CanvasKit or skwasm renderer.

front: Symptom: Hot reload doesn't apply — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Native code / const / enum changed · Fix: Hot restart; full restart

front: Symptom: Release crash, debug OK — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Obfuscation renamed symbol · Fix: --split-debug-info; retain mapping

front: Symptom: Gradle / SDK errors — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: JDK, AGP, compileSdk mismatch · Fix: Align android/build.gradle with Flutter docs for version

front: Symptom: Signing failed — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Wrong alias/password · Fix: Verify key.properties; path to keystore

front: Symptom: iOS provisioning — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Cert expired · Fix: Regenerate in Apple Developer portal

front: Symptom: Huge APK — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Single ABI fat apk · Fix: --split-per-abi or use AAB

front: Symptom: Web blank screen — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Base href / renderer · Fix: --base-href /app/; check console for wasm errors

front: Symptom: versionCode rejected — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Monotonic build number · Fix: Bump +N in pubspec

front: Gotcha with Flutter build and release: what silently fails?
back: Never commit keystore or key.properties — use CI secrets; losing keystore = can't update app id on Play.

front: When should you NOT use Flutter build and release?
back: Shipping debug builds — larger, slower, asserts enabled. Obfuscation without symbol backup — crash reports become useless. Manual APK for Play Store — prefer AAB for dynamic delivery.
